scope: Offline catalog signature, hash-table membership, PLAT version and recovery preparation

signature.message: RSA/SHA-256 catalog signature and signed attributes verified. This does not establish signer trust or device acceptance.

hash_table_binding.message: Signed catalog member matches the FFU hash table using legacy SHA-1. Legacy collision resistance is not a modern authenticity guarantee.

signer_trust.message: An embedded certificate is not a trust anchor. OEM chain, device root-key binding, certificate policy/time and revocation have not been validated.

reference.browser: Headless Microsoft Edge, built production WASM worker
reference.ambiguous_signed_attributes: Windows signature-only accepts the duplicate-digest fixture; Rust deliberately rejects ambiguous critical attributes

blockers: Device workflow is not implemented and hardware-validated in this release; execution is blocked.
An embedded certificate is not a trust anchor. OEM chain, device root-key binding, certificate policy/time and revocation have not been validated.
No unambiguous PLAT SWVERSION was found; never infer firmware compatibility from the filename.
Read an image PLAT version and installed phone version before comparing them. Filename versions and unsupported version formats are not applicability evidence.
The phone platform has not been established. Normal-mode information queries do not read a platform ID.
Stock recovery requires a validated FlashApp connection and identity checks after reconnection. This preview does not change phone modes.
No stock recovery workflow is hardware validated for this exact variant, firmware, host and transport. Identification evidence does not establish write support.
Native phone backup access is not implemented yet. Preserve recoverable originals and establish a data preservation plan before recovery.
Stock recovery currently runs only in protocol replay tests. No physical-device executor is enabled.
steps: Inspect the local FFU, verify chunk hashes and record its SHA-256 fingerprint
Establish phone identity, exact firmware applicability, authenticity and a data preservation plan
Implement and validate mode transitions, reconnection, native recovery execution and interruption handling before enabling recovery

limits: Mathematical signature and signed member binding are verified; independent OEM root trust, chain policy/time/revocation, device acceptance and validated recovery applicability remain unknown.
The signed catalog member uses legacy SHA-1; no modern collision-resistance claim or write permission follows.
No PLAT SWVERSION was found. The filename is not accepted as an observed image version.
Native preparation verified all chunk hashes and full-file fingerprint; browser verified catalog/table binding only and leaves full-image hash checks unverified.
Only metadata, source-code hashes and certificate fingerprint are retained; proprietary firmware/catalog bytes, personal file paths and USB identifiers are excluded.
